explanation: Sense and Sensibility (1811) was credited only to 'A Lady', and later books to 'the Author of' her earlier ones. Her name was made public after her death in 1817.

claims.text: None of the novels Jane Austen published in her lifetime carried her name.
Sense and Sensibility, published in 1811, was credited to 'A Lady'.
Austen's later novels were credited to 'the Author of' her earlier books, such as Sense and Sensibility.
Austen was first publicly named as the author in her brother Henry's biographical notice, published after her death in 1817.
